commands:
- **/help** `Displays the bot's help menu.`
- **/links** `Displays the bot's links.`
- **/add-channel** `Sets/resets the bot addition channel.`
- **/log-channel** `Sets/resets the log channel.`
- **/authorization-channel** `Sets/resets the moderator channel.`
- **/bot-role** `Sets/resets the bot role.`
- **/authorization-role** `Sets/resets the moderator role.`
- **/developer-role** `Sets/resets the developer role.`
- **/dm-tracker** `Toggles the DM tracking system on/off.`
- **/server-requirement** `Adds a minimum server requirement for adding bots.`
- **/topgg-requirement** `Toggles the top.gg requirement on/off.`
- **/remove-bot** `Deletes a bot's data from the system.`
- **/botlist settings** `Displays the botlist system settings.`
- **/botlist reset** `Resets the configured botlist settings.`
- **/botlist enable** `Enables the botlist system.`
- **/botlist disable** `Disables the botlist system.`
limit-set: Server requirement for adding bots successfully set to (**{limit}**).
no-text-channel: The channel to set must be a text channel.
no-authorized: You do not have permission to use this command.
botlist-reset: All configured botlist settings have been reset.
links:
- **Add the bot to your server to use the advanced botlist system.**
- **Join the support server to report bugs and suggestions.**
- ~~**Support us by voting.**~~
no-settings: All settings must be configured to enable the botlist system. Error codes: **({errorCode})** For more details on error codes, please visit our support server.
system-message: - {emoji} **To add a bot, click the `Add Bot` button under the menu.**
dont-bot: You must enter a valid bot.
bot-added: Bot added to the system. Follow progress in the (<#{log}>) channel.
bot-already: Bot is already in the system. Added by: (<@{owner}>), status: (**{status}**)
no-bot: The bot is not in the system.
bot-content: <@{user}> Your bot has been added to the queue.
bot-banned: Bot (<@{bot}>) by owner (**{owner}**) was banned because they left the server.
bot-delete: Bot data deleted from the system.
bot-added-dm: Your request to add the bot to (**{guild}**) has been submitted.
bot-rejected-dm: Your bot added to (**{guild}**) was rejected ({reason}).
bot-approved-dm: Your bot added to (**{guild}**) has been approved.
bot-banned-dm1: Your bot added to (**{guild}**) was banned because you are not in the server.
bot-banned-dm2: Your bot in (**{guild}**) was banned because you left the server.
bot-banned-dm3: Your bot added to (**{guild}**) was banned because it is no longer in the server.
not-topgg: Top.gg approval is required to add a bot.
not-enough: Your bot must be in at least **{limit}** servers. Current server count: (**{server}**).
